title: Kimi auto-approve allowlist admits CronCreate but not CronDelete (and other Kimi cron tools), so an auto-approve session still shows a manual card for CronDelete
outcome: Kimi auto-approve allowlist admits CronCreate but not CronDelete (and other Kimi cron tools), so an auto-approve session still shows a manual card for CronDelete
acceptance: A read-only Kimi delegation child is not widened by this change: its gate still refuses the cron tools; a test shows the refusal.

In a Kimi session whose approval mode is auto-approve, a permission request for CronDelete is approved by the host without an approval card, as CronCreate is today; a test in the Kimi approvals tests fails without the fix and passes with it.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and fingerprint cited in a note.

The set of Kimi tools the host auto-approves is one named list in the code; every Kimi cron tool that asks for permission is on it or is left off for a reason stated beside the list; a test pins the list.
docs/features/kimi-cli-integration.md names the tools that auto-approve covers.
